slides.headline: THE BIT YOU ACTUALLY WANT TO [[KNOW]].
slides.body: Answers before you have to ask.

slides.headline: [[DAVE]] SONNTAG.
slides.body: Thirty years behind a drum kit, a working musician, and a facilitator with a WA youth mental health charity. Working With Children Check. SafeTALK trained.

rows.label: HOURS
rows.value: 9am – 3pm. Drop off and pick up at the door.

rows.label: VENUE
rows.value: Player 1 Music School, 5 Woodville Lane, North Perth

slides.headline: KEPT [[SMALL]] ON PURPOSE.
slides.body: Small enough that every kid gets heard instead of lost in a crowd.

slides.headline: [[NOBODY]] MISSES OUT.
slides.body: $80 for the two days — a foundation price for our first program. If that's still a barrier, email Dave for a partial or full place. No questions asked, no awkwardness.

slides.headline: NOT A LESSON. NOT [[THERAPY]].
slides.body: It's a room where your kid makes something real with other kids. There's something therapeutic in that — but we're musicians, not clinicians.
